caveats: Although these health district boundaries correspond by P-code to  the [Burkina Faso administrative level 0-3 boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/burkina-faso-administrative-boundaries) they were derived from a previous version of those boundaries.  Thus they roll up to province and department boundaries that are similar but not identical to the COD-AB.
methodology_other: Developed by Institut Géographique du Burkina (IGB).  P-coded by OCHA.
name: burkina-faso-health-districts-districts-de-sante
notes:
Burkina Faso health districts (districts de santé) P-coded and fitting below [Burkina Faso administrative level 0-3 boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/burkina-faso-administrative-boundaries) administrative level 2 (department).

Example P-code:  BFDS130001
  
BF is the ADM0_FR,  representing Burkina Faso

  DS means "District de santé"

 13 is from ADM1_PCODE BF13

 00 is from ADM2_PCODE BF1300

 01 means District de santé number 01 within BF1300
